column1: # 语法备注英文 (hand-authored, NOT machine-translated). 中文备注<TAB>English.
# Keyed by the EXACT 备注 text in the xlsx; merged into each grammar point as noteEn by convert_grammar.py.
疑问词句末一般不用“吗”。
column2: With a question word, you normally don't add 吗 at the end.

column1: “是”连接名词身份，不直接放在普通形容词前。
column2: 是 links nouns/identities; don't put it directly before a plain adjective.

column1: 有“什么、谁、哪”等疑问词时通常不用“吗”。
column2: When a question word like 什么/谁/哪 is present, 吗 is usually not used.

column1: “哪”常放在名词前，如“哪国”。
column2: 哪 usually comes before a noun, e.g. 哪国 (which country).

column1: 亲属或很亲近的关系有时可以省略“的”，第12课会学习。
column2: With family or very close relationships, 的 can sometimes be dropped (see Lesson 12).

column1: 前文已经说过的问题，可以用“呢”避免重复。
column2: Use 呢 to ask the same question already mentioned, without repeating it.

column1: “几”常用于预期数量较小的情况。
column2: 几 is used when the expected number is small.

column1: 这里的“了”不是第14课“动作完成”的“了”。
column2: This 了 is not the "completed action" 了 taught in Lesson 14.

column1: “多大”和“几岁”都可以问年龄。
column2: Both 多大 and 几岁 can ask someone's age.

column1: “会”强调学会的技能；第10课“能”更多表示条件允许或许可。
column2: 会 stresses a learned skill; 能 (Lesson 10) is more about being allowed/possible.

column1: 初级阶段可记：主语 + 很 + 形容词，不用“是”。
column2: At this level just remember: Subject + 很 + adjective, with no 是.

column1: “怎么”后面通常跟动作；“怎么样”第12课表示“怎么样/如何”。
column2: 怎么 is usually followed by an action; 怎么样 (Lesson 12) means "how/how about".

column1: 口语常用“号”，书面也常用“日”。
column2: Speech usually uses 号; writing often uses 日.

column1: 口语中有时能听到“今天是……”，但本课核心是掌握名词谓语句。
column2: You may hear "今天是…" in speech, but the point here is the noun-predicate sentence.

column1: 两个动作按发生顺序排列：先“去”，再做第二个动作。
column2: The two actions follow their real order: first 去, then the second action.

column1: “想”后面直接接动作。
column2: 想 is followed directly by an action.

column1: “多少”后面的量词有时可以省略，如“多少人”。
column2: The measure word after 多少 can sometimes be dropped, e.g. 多少人.

column1: 初学可先记“个”是常用通用量词；“口”常用于家庭人口。
column2: First learn 个 as the general measure word; 口 is used for family members.

column1: “块”是口语里常用的人民币“元”。
column2: 块 is the colloquial word for the currency unit 元 (yuan).

column1: 这里“在”本身就是谓语，表示“位于”。
column2: Here 在 is itself the predicate, meaning "to be located (at)".

column1: “哪儿”和“哪里”意思相同；HSK1课本常用“哪儿”。
column2: 哪儿 and 哪里 mean the same; HSK1 texts prefer 哪儿.

column1: 比较：我在学校（位置） vs. 我在学校学习（动作地点）。
column2: Compare: 我在学校 (location) vs. 我在学校学习 (place of an action).

column1: 需要有上下文；这里“呢”省略了“在哪儿”。
column2: Context is needed here; 呢 leaves out "在哪儿 (where)".

column1: “有”的否定是“没有”，不是“不有”。
column2: The negative of 有 is 没有, never 不有.

column1: 初级阶段主要用“和”连接名词，不用来连接完整句子。
column2: At this level 和 links nouns, not whole sentences.

column1: “能”常与条件、可能或许可有关；“会”更偏向学会的技能。
column2: 能 is about conditions/possibility/permission; 会 is more about a learned skill.

column1: “请”放在动作前，让请求更礼貌。
column2: Put 请 before an action to make a request more polite.

column1: 口语中“分”有时可以省略：三点十分 → 三点十。
column2: In speech 分 can be dropped: 三点十分 → 三点十.

column1: 汉语时间通常放在动词前。
column2: In Chinese, time expressions usually go before the verb.

column1: “时间点 + 前”= before；“时长 + 前”常表示 ago。
column2: Time-point + 前 = "before"; duration + 前 usually means "ago".

column1: “怎么”问做法；“怎么样”问情况、评价或状态。
column2: 怎么 asks how to do something; 怎么样 asks about a situation, opinion or state.

column1: 不是所有“的”都能省；本课先掌握亲属和亲近关系。
column2: Not every 的 can be dropped; here just master family/close relationships.

column1: 语气可根据上下文表示“太……了”或强烈感叹“真……”。
column2: Depending on context it can mean "too…" or a strong exclamation "really…".

column1: 这里“会”表示将来可能，不是第6课“会做某事”的技能。
column2: Here 会 means future likelihood, not the "know how to" skill of Lesson 6.

column1: 电话里通常读 wéi。
column2: On the phone it is usually read wéi.

column1: “呢”可以省略：我在看书。
column2: 呢 can be dropped: 我在看书 (I'm reading).

column1: 电话号码不按“几十、几百”读，而是一个数字一个数字地读。
column2: Phone numbers are read digit by digit, not as tens/hundreds.

column1: “吧”让语气更柔和，常译为 “let’s / okay / why don’t…”.
column2: 吧 softens the tone, often "let's / okay / why don't…".

column1: 和第5课句末“了（变化）”区分：这里强调动作已经完成。
column2: Unlike the sentence-final 了 (change) in Lesson 5, this 了 stresses a completed action.

column1: “前”= before；“后”= after。
column2: 前 = before; 后 = after.

column1: “啊”主要表达语气，英文常没有固定对应词。
column2: 啊 mainly conveys tone and often has no fixed English equivalent.

column1: “都”通常放在动词或形容词前。
column2: 都 usually comes before the verb or adjective.

column1: 肯定句中“是”有时可省；否定通常用“不是……的”。
column2: 是 can sometimes be dropped in positive sentences; the negative is 不是…的.

column1: 年份按数字逐个读，如 2016 读“二零一六年”。
column2: Years are read digit by digit, e.g. 2016 = 二零一六年.

column1: HSK2里“要”常表示愿望、计划；否定愿望可用“不想/不要”，语境要自然。
column2: In HSK2, 要 often means want/plan; negate the wish with 不想/不要 as context fits.

column1: “最”表示在几个对象中程度最高。
column2: 最 marks the highest degree among several things.

column1: “十几”通常约11–19；“二十多”表示20以上、不满30。
column2: 十几 is roughly 11–19; 二十多 means over 20 but under 30.

column1: “是不是”比单纯“吗”更有确认语气。
column2: 是不是 carries more of a "confirm it, right?" tone than plain 吗.

column1: “每”常和“都”一起出现：每个人都……
column2: 每 often pairs with 都: 每个人都… (everyone…).

column1: 常见搭配：多大、多高、多远、多久（更高等级会继续扩展）。
column2: Common pairings: 多大/多高/多远/多久 (expanded at higher levels).

column1: “的”后面的名词可以省略，但听话人必须知道说的是什么。
column2: The noun after 的 can be dropped if the listener knows what is meant.

column1: 常用于请求，语气比只说动词更柔和。
column2: Often used for requests; softer than just saying the verb.

column1: “真”常带感叹语气。
column2: 真 usually carries an exclamatory tone.

column1: 用于已经发生的事情，强调“谁做的”。
column2: Used for a past event, stressing "who did it".

column1: “的时候”前面可以放时间、动作或小句。
column2: Before …的时候 you can put a time, an action or a clause.

column1: 常见结构：已经……了。
column2: Common pattern: 已经…了.

column1: “就”常表达“早、快、顺利、紧接着”。
column2: 就 often conveys early / quick / smooth / right after.

column1: “还没……” = “not yet”.
column2: 还没… = "not yet".

column1: “有点儿”通常放在形容词前。
column2: 有点儿 usually goes before an adjective.

column1: HSK1的“怎么”主要问方法；这里学习“怎么”问原因。
column2: HSK1's 怎么 asks "how"; here 怎么 asks "why".

column1: HSK2重点掌握“个个”；常和“都”搭配。
column2: Focus on 个个 here; it often pairs with 都.

column1: 口语里有时可省略“因为”或“所以”，初学先掌握完整结构。
column2: In speech 因为 or 所以 can be dropped; beginners should learn the full pattern first.

column1: 本课强调“状态还在继续”。
column2: This lesson stresses that a state is still continuing.

column1: 和“才”形成对比会在更高等级继续学习。
column2: The contrast with 才 is studied further at higher levels.

column1: “离”后面放参照地点。
column2: Put the reference place after 离.

column1: 本课“呢”强调当前动作或状态。
column2: Here 呢 stresses the current action or state.

column1: 语气比较柔和，常用于建议或请求。
column2: The tone is soft; often used for suggestions or requests.

column1: “再”多用于还没有发生的重复；“又”多用于已经发生的重复。
column2: 再 is for repetition not yet happened; 又 is for repetition already happened.

column1: 本级先掌握最常见的“让、请、叫 + 人 + 动词”。
column2: At this level master the common 让/请/叫 + person + verb.

column1: 单音节动词常用AA或A一A；语气轻松。
column2: Monosyllabic verbs use AA or A一A; the tone is casual.

column1: HSK2常见：看见、听懂、做完、写错、找到。
column2: Common in HSK2: 看见, 听懂, 做完, 写错, 找到.

column1: “从”可以介绍地点、时间或过程的起点。
column2: 从 introduces the starting point of a place, time or process.

column1: “第”把基数词变成序数词。
column2: 第 turns a cardinal number into an ordinal.

column1: “别”更口语；“不要”也很常用。
column2: 别 is more colloquial; 不要 is also very common.

column1: “对”后面是动作、态度或评价所针对的对象。
column2: After 对 comes the target of the action, attitude or judgement.

column1: 定语较长时，“的”通常不能省。
column2: When the modifier is long, 的 usually cannot be dropped.

column1: “比”字句里形容词前一般不用“很”。
column2: In a 比 sentence, don't put 很 before the adjective.

column1: “可能”表示不确定的判断。
column2: 可能 expresses an uncertain judgement.

column1: 有宾语时常重复动词：他说汉语说得很好。
column2: With an object the verb is repeated: 他说汉语说得很好.

column1: 本课是在基本“比”字句上的程度扩展。
column2: This extends the basic 比 sentence to express degree of difference.

column1: “着”强调状态持续；不要和“正在……呢”的进行动作混淆。
column2: 着 stresses a continuing state; don't confuse it with the ongoing action 正在…呢.

column1: 形式是疑问，常带“我以为是这样”的语气。
column2: It looks like a question but carries an "I thought so" tone.

column1: “往”后面常接前、后、左、右等方向词。
column2: 往 is often followed by a direction word: 前/后/左/右.

column1: 否定常用“没(有) + 动词 + 过”。
column2: The negative is usually 没(有) + verb + 过.

column1: “虽然”说明让步条件，“但是”引出转折结果。
column2: 虽然 states a concession; 但是 introduces the contrasting result.

column1: “次”是最常用的动作次数量词。
column2: 次 is the most common measure word for number of times.

column1: 表示临近发生；“快要/就要”更强调“马上”。
column2: Shows something is about to happen; 快要/就要 stresses "very soon".

column1: 常带说话人的感情色彩：觉得时间晚、数量多、情况已经明显。
column2: Carries the speaker's feeling: it's late, it's a lot, or it's already obvious.

column1: “好”表示动作完成，并常有“已经准备好”的意思。
column2: 好 marks completion, often with the sense of "ready/done well".

column1: “不”多否定习惯/现在；“没”多否定已经发生的动作。
column2: 不 negates habits/present states; 没 negates actions that have (not) happened.

column1: 这里“那”不是指示代词“that”，而是承接前文结果。
column2: Here 那 is not the demonstrative "that"; it links to the previous statement.

column1: 两个动作按时间先后排列，第二个动作紧接着发生。
column2: The two actions follow time order; the second happens right after the first.

column1: 地点宾语常放在“来/去”前：回学校去；事物宾语位置较灵活。
column2: A place object goes before 来/去 (回学校去); a thing object is more flexible.

column1: 反问不是在真正提问，而是强调说话人的判断。
column2: A rhetorical question isn't a real question; it stresses the speaker's judgement.

column1: 最简单记法：有选择的疑问句用“还是”；陈述句常用“或者”。
column2: Simple rule: use 还是 in choice questions, 或者 in statements.

column1: 重点是“存在 + 持续状态”，不是强调动作正在进行。
column2: The point is existence + a lasting state, not an action in progress.

column1: 这里“会”表示可能，不是“会说汉语”的技能意义。
column2: Here 会 means likelihood, not the "know how to" sense (as in 会说汉语).

column1: 两个部分一般是相同词性的特点或动作。
column2: The two parts are usually features/actions of the same word class.

column1: V1是伴随状态，V2是主要动作。
column2: V1 is the accompanying manner/state; V2 is the main action.

column1: 重点是“现在和以前不一样了”。
column2: The point is "things are different from before now".

column1: “越来越”后面通常直接接形容词或少数心理动词。
column2: 越来越 is usually followed directly by an adjective or a few mental verbs.

column1: 可能补语说“能不能达到结果”，和一般的“能 + 动词”意思接近但结构不同。
column2: A potential complement says whether a result can be reached; close to 能 + verb but different in structure.

column1: 这里“呢”省略了“在哪儿”。
column2: Here 呢 leaves out "在哪儿 (where)".

column1: “刚”是副词；“刚才”是时间名词，可以放在主语前。
column2: 刚 is an adverb; 刚才 is a time noun and can go before the subject.

column1: “时段”表示长度，如十分钟、两个月、三年。
column2: A duration shows length, e.g. ten minutes, two months, three years.

column1: “感兴趣”前常用介词“对”引出对象。
column2: Use 对 before 感兴趣 to introduce what you're interested in.

column1: “刻”=15分钟；“差”从下一个整点往前算。
column2: 刻 = 15 minutes; 差 counts back from the next full hour.

column1: 简单记：过去/已发生多用“又”；未来/还没发生多用“再”。
column2: Simple rule: 又 for the past/done, 再 for the future/not yet.

column1: 前后通常使用同一个疑问代词；此时不是真正提问。
column2: The same question word appears twice; it isn't a real question.

column1: 两个“越”后面的内容可以是动作，也可以是状态。
column2: After each 越 you can have either an action or a state.

column1: “一样”后可直接结束，也可再加形容词说明哪方面一样。
column2: 一样 can end the clause or be followed by an adjective saying how they're alike.

column1: “很/非常”一般不能直接放在“比”字句的形容词前。
column2: 很/非常 normally can't go before the adjective in a 比 sentence.

column1: 一般使用相邻数字，如“一两、两三、四五”。
column2: Use adjacent numbers, e.g. 一两, 两三, 四五.

column1: “把”后的宾语通常是明确、已知的事物；动词后一般不能什么都没有。
column2: The 把 object is usually definite/known, and the verb can't stand bare afterwards.

column1: “左右”放在数量表达后面。
column2: 左右 goes after the quantity.

column1: “才”常让人感觉晚、慢、少；“就”常让人感觉早、快、容易。
column2: 才 feels late/slow/few; 就 feels early/fast/easy.

column1: 本课重点是“把”字句后出现地点或接受者：在、到、给。
column2: Focus: the 把 sentence with a place or recipient after the verb: 在/到/给.

column1: “来”朝说话人方向，“去”离开说话人方向。
column2: 来 is toward the speaker; 去 is away from the speaker.

column1: 两个动作通常可以同时进行。
column2: The two actions usually happen at the same time.

column1: 本课强调“把”字句中的结果补语或趋向补语。
column2: Focus: a result or directional complement in the 把 sentence.

column1: “再”常用于下一步；“又”可用于叙述已经发生的第二个动作。
column2: 再 is for the next step; 又 can narrate a second action that already happened.

column1: “都”常表示排除一个范围；“还/也”常表示在原有内容上增加。
column2: 都 excludes (except…); 还/也 add one more item.

column1: 这里“什么”不是要求一个确定答案，而表示不确定的人或事物。
column2: Here 什么 doesn't ask for a definite answer; it means "something/anything".

column1: “极了”放在形容词后面，程度比“很”强。
column2: 极了 goes after an adjective and is stronger than 很.

column1: “的话”可以省略，但“如果……就……”是最清楚的基本结构。
column2: 的话 can be dropped, but 如果…就… is the clearest basic pattern.

column1: “得”后面不是简单形容词，而可以是一整个短语或小句。
column2: After 得 you can have a whole phrase or clause, not just one adjective.

column1: 常用来描写外貌和事物特点，语气生动。
column2: Often describes looks and features, in a vivid tone.

column1: 双音节动词一般用ABAB，不说AABB。
column2: Two-syllable verbs reduplicate as ABAB, not AABB.

column1: 这些疑问代词不表示疑问，而表示一个范围里的“每一个/任何一个”。
column2: Here the question words aren't questions; they mean "every/any one".

column1: “只要”强调这个条件一满足，后面的结果就可以发生。
column2: 只要 stresses that once the condition is met, the result can happen.

column1: “关于 + 话题”常放在句首；修饰名词时常用“关于……的 + 名词”。
column2: 关于 + topic often opens the sentence; to modify a noun use 关于…的 + noun.

column1: HSK3重点掌握“出来=产生/识别”，“下来=状态由强到弱/由动到静”，“起来=回忆有结果”。
column2: Focus: 出来 = produce/identify, 下来 = fading/settling, 起来 = successful recall.

column1: “使”较书面；“叫、让”更口语。三者都可以表示“使某人/某物产生某种结果”。
column2: 使 is more formal; 叫/让 are colloquial; all mean "cause someone/something to…".

column1: HSK3先掌握最基本结构；否定通常用“没（有）被……”。
column2: Learn the basic pattern first; the negative is usually 没(有)被….

column1: “只要……就……”=条件够了就行；“只有……才……”=这个条件是必须的。
column2: 只要…就… = enough condition; 只有…才… = a necessary condition.

column1: 两个分句主语相同时，“不仅”一般放在主语后。
column2: When both clauses share a subject, 不仅 usually goes after the subject.

column1: “从来”最常和否定形式一起使用。
column2: 从来 is most often used with a negative.

column1: “刚才”可以放在主语前；“刚”一般紧靠动词。
column2: 刚才 can go before the subject; 刚 stays close to the verb.

column1: 前面是假设条件，后面的结果不受这个条件影响。
column2: The first part is a hypothetical; the result holds regardless of it.

column1: 这里的“上”不是方位，而是表示某个方面。
column2: Here 上 isn't a location; it marks an aspect/respect.

column1: “正好”表示时间、数量或情况非常合适。
column2: 正好 means a time, amount or situation fits perfectly.

column1: “差不多”还能表示两者接近；“几乎”更常修饰动作或范围。
column2: 差不多 can mean "close/similar"; 几乎 more often modifies an action or scope.

column1: “尽管”说的是已经存在的事实，后面出现与预期不同的结果。
column2: 尽管 states an existing fact, followed by an unexpected result.

column1: “却”一般放在第二个分句的主语后、谓语前。
column2: 却 usually sits after the subject and before the predicate of the second clause.

column1: “而”比“但是、和”更书面，具体意思要看上下文。
column2: 而 is more formal than 但是/和; its exact sense depends on context.

column1: 口语中很常见，句尾常加“的”。
column2: Very common in speech, often ending with 的.

column1: “本来”强调原来的计划或情况，后来可能发生变化。
column2: 本来 stresses the original plan/situation, which may later change.

column1: “另”通常不能单独使用；“另外”可以连接补充信息。
column2: 另 usually can't stand alone; 另外 can introduce extra information.

column1: 常用于比较正式地列出两点或多点。
column2: Used to list two or more points fairly formally.

column1: “不管”后常用疑问词、正反形式或选择关系。
column2: 不管 is followed by a question word, a yes-no form, or a choice.

column1: “以为”常暗示后来发现原来的想法不对。
column2: 以为 implies you later found your assumption was wrong.

column1: “原来”常有“现在才知道”的感觉；“本来”强调原先。
column2: 原来 carries "I only just realized"; 本来 stresses the original state.

column1: “并”在这种用法中通常必须和否定词一起出现。
column2: In this use 并 must appear together with a negative.

column1: “按照”后面常接计划、规定、方法、要求等。
column2: 按照 is followed by a plan, rule, method, requirement, etc.

column1: “甚至”后面的情况通常比前面更特别、更进一步。
column2: What follows 甚至 is usually more extreme than what came before.

column1: 作副词时表示很有把握；作动词时表示“确认/认为确定”。
column2: As an adverb it means "surely"; as a verb, "to confirm/be sure".

column1: 要根据上下文判断是“补充理由”还是“以后再谈”。
column2: Context decides whether it adds a reason or means "talk about it later".

column1: “实际”常修饰名词；“实际上”常修饰整个句子。
column2: 实际 usually modifies a noun; 实际上 modifies the whole sentence.

column1: 表示评价或判断所站的角度。
column2: Marks the viewpoint from which a judgement is made.

column1: “尤其”常用于从前面范围中突出一个；“特别”用途更广。
column2: 尤其 singles one out from a set; 特别 is broader in use.

column1: “竟然”带明显的惊讶、出乎意料语气。
column2: 竟然 carries clear surprise, "unexpectedly".

column1: 注意英语和汉语对倍数理解有时不同；初学先掌握“A是B的两倍”。
column2: Multiples work differently in English/Chinese; first master "A 是 B 的两倍".

column1: “值得”后接动作；“值”常直接接价格或价值。
column2: 值得 is followed by an action; 值 is followed by a price or value.

column1: 前文先有一个整体范围，“其中”再从里面提出一部分。
column2: First a whole is mentioned; 其中 then singles out a part of it.

column1: 这里的“下”不是方位，而表示条件、环境或影响。
column2: Here 下 isn't a location; it marks a condition/environment/influence.

column1: “估计”强调人的判断；“可能”直接表示可能性。
column2: 估计 stresses a person's estimate; 可能 states possibility directly.

column1: 反义形式是“来得及”。
column2: Its opposite is 来得及 (to have enough time).

column1: 离合词不能简单按普通双音节动词重叠成ABAB。
column2: Separable verbs don't reduplicate as ABAB like ordinary two-syllable verbs.

column1: “要是”比“如果”更口语。
column2: 要是 is more colloquial than 如果.

column1: 强调两个特点或情况同时存在。
column2: Stresses that two features/situations coexist.

column1: “使”比较书面；口语中常用“让”。
column2: 使 is more formal; speech prefers 让.

column1: 强调这个条件一满足，后面的结果就可以发生。
column2: Stresses that once the condition holds, the result can occur.

column1: 是口语固定说法，不是普通的“不是”否定句。
column2: A fixed spoken expression, not an ordinary 不是 negative.

column1: “因此”常用于书面语或较正式表达。
column2: 因此 is used in writing or more formal speech.

column1: “往往”常和某种条件、规律一起出现；“经常/常”更普通。
column2: 往往 pairs with a condition/pattern; 经常/常 are more general.

column1: 反问通常表达说话人已经有明显判断。
column2: The rhetorical question shows the speaker already has a clear judgement.

column1: “通过”强调手段；“经过”强调过程或经过某地。
column2: 通过 stresses the means; 经过 stresses the process or passing a place.

column1: “可是”与“但是”意思接近，口语很常用。
column2: 可是 is close to 但是 and very common in speech.

column1: 常表示事情最后出现的实际结果。
column2: Marks the actual result that finally occurred.

column1: “上”放在百、千、万前表示大概超过这个数量级。
column2: 上 before 百/千/万 means "up to/over" that order of magnitude.

column1: “不过”常用于补充一个限制；“但是”是普通转折。
column2: 不过 adds a mild qualification; 但是 is a plain contrast.

column1: 强调说话人确认某个事实是真的。
column2: Stresses the speaker confirms a fact is true.

column1: 用于明确说明一个观点是从谁的角度出发。
column2: Makes clear whose viewpoint an opinion comes from.

column1: “由于”更书面，后面常和“因此”搭配。
column2: 由于 is more formal and often pairs with 因此.

column1: “比如”后面直接给出具体例子。
column2: 比如 is followed directly by a concrete example.

column1: “连”提出最意外或最极端的例子，“都/也”呼应。
column2: 连 raises the most surprising/extreme case, echoed by 都/也.

column1: 前面通常是应该做的事，后面说明不这样做的结果。
column2: The first part is what should be done; then the result of not doing it.

column1: 两者基本意思相同；“无论”书面感稍强。
column2: The two are basically the same; 无论 feels a bit more formal.

column1: 比“但是、可是”更书面。
column2: More formal than 但是/可是.

column1: 既可以表示两件事同一时间发生，也可以连接并列信息。
column2: Can mean two things happen at once, or link parallel information.

column1: “并且”比“而且”更适合连接两个并列动作或情况。
column2: 并且 suits linking two parallel actions/situations better than 而且.

column1: 配套课程标注为HSK5扩展；教材中出现，可作为理解项。
column2: Marked as an HSK5 extension; appears in the text as a comprehension item.

column1: 配套课程标注为HSK5扩展；“对于”偏对象，“关于”偏话题。
column2: HSK5 extension: 对于 targets an object, 关于 a topic.

column1: 通常和“都”一起使用。
column2: Usually used together with 都.

column1: 可作形容词，也可放在后一个分句前表示相反结果。
column2: Can be an adjective, or open the second clause to show an opposite result.

column1: “大概”还能表示约数；“也许”主要表示可能性。
column2: 大概 can also give an approximate number; 也许 mainly shows possibility.

column1: 频率低于“有时、经常”。
column2: Lower in frequency than 有时/经常.

column1: “由”比较书面，可表示起点，也可引出负责人。
column2: 由 is formal; it can mark a starting point or introduce who's responsible.

column1: 常和“讨论、调查、研究、比赛、考试”等搭配。
column2: Often pairs with 讨论/调查/研究/比赛/考试.

column1: 前后通常是一起发展或变化的情况。
column2: The two parts usually develop or change together.

column1: “够 + 形容词”表示程度达到要求。
column2: 够 + adjective means the degree meets the requirement.

column1: “以”常和上、下、东、西等组成固定方位/范围表达。
column2: 以 combines with 上/下/东/西 into fixed position/range expressions.

column1: “既然”提出已经确定的事实，“就”给出自然结论。
column2: 既然 states an established fact; 就 gives the natural conclusion.

column1: “于是”常讲故事中的顺序结果；“因此”更偏逻辑因果。
column2: 于是 tells a sequential result in a story; 因此 is more logical cause-effect.

column1: 口语常用，表示还有别的类似内容没有全部说出来。
column2: Colloquial; means there are more similar things left unsaid.

column1: “起来”在这里不是实际方向，而表示记忆从无到有。
column2: Here 起来 isn't a real direction; it marks recall coming to mind.

column1: 口语里用途很广，常和结果补语一起使用。
column2: Very versatile in speech, often used with a result complement.

column1: “千万”语气更强，常用于提醒、警告；“一定”更普通。
column2: 千万 is stronger, for reminders/warnings; 一定 is more neutral.

column1: 本课重点是“来”表示由谁做某件事。
column2: Focus: 来 indicating who will take on an action.

column1: 放在数量表达后面。
column2: Placed after the quantity.

column1: 这里“可”不是“可以”，而是加强说话人的语气。
column2: Here 可 isn't 可以; it strengthens the speaker's tone.

column1: “恐怕”常是委婉地表达担心或不好的判断。
column2: 恐怕 politely expresses worry or a bad guess.

column1: 常带着急、好奇或追问的语气。
column2: Carries an impatient, curious or pressing tone.

column1: 用于从一个具体例子开始说明观点。
column2: Used to make a point starting from a concrete example.

column1: 表示有没有勇气做某事。
column2: Shows whether one dares to do something.

column1: “倒”常有“跟想象不一样”或温和转折的感觉。
column2: 倒 often feels "contrary to expectation" or a mild turn.

column1: 很口语，具体意思由宾语决定。
column2: Very colloquial; its meaning depends on the object.

column1: “趟”强调来回/去一处的行程；“次”适用范围更广。
column2: 趟 stresses a trip to and from a place; 次 is broader.

column1: “而”有时可以省略；完整结构更正式。
column2: 而 can sometimes be dropped; the full pattern is more formal.

column1: “仍然”比“还”正式，常出现在书面语。
column2: 仍然 is more formal than 还 and common in writing.

column1: 多用于书面语、间接疑问句。
column2: Mostly used in writing and indirect questions.

column1: 表示身体或心理上能不能承受。
column2: Shows whether one can physically or mentally bear it.

column1: “接着”更强调紧接前面的动作。
column2: 接着 stresses coming right after the previous action.

column1: “此”指前面已经说过的内容。
column2: 此 refers to what was just mentioned.

column1: 表示给人、事物或概念一个名称。
column2: Gives a name to a person, thing or concept.

column1: 前面其实可以理解为省略了“不管/无论”。
column2: The first part can be read as omitting 不管/无论.

column1: “上”除了方向，还能表示动作达到结果或进入一种新状态。
column2: Besides direction, 上 can mark reaching a result or entering a new state.

column1: 常见引申：看出来、听出来、想出来、说出来。
column2: Common extensions: 看出来, 听出来, 想出来, 说出来.

column1: 常放在总结句的开头。
column2: Usually opens a summarizing sentence.

column1: 常和“问题、关键、原因、区别”等词搭配。
column2: Often pairs with 问题/关键/原因/区别.

column1: 表示一个动作持续一段时间后发生新的情况。
column2: Shows a new situation arising after an action goes on for a while.

column1: 两个动作相隔时间很短。
column2: The two actions are only a very short time apart.

column1: 两者意思很接近；“到底”口语更常见。
column2: The two are very close; 到底 is more common in speech.

column1: 常见：看起来、听起来、吃起来，以及“天气冷起来了”。
column2: Common: 看起来, 听起来, 吃起来, and 天气冷起来了.

column1: 常见固定搭配：说起、谈起、提起。
column2: Common fixed pairings: 说起, 谈起, 提起.

column1: “如何”较书面，“怎么”更口语。
column2: 如何 is more formal; 怎么 is more colloquial.

column1: 常见：靠自己、靠努力、靠经验。
column2: Common: 靠自己, 靠努力, 靠经验.

column1: 和“竟然”意思接近，常带惊讶语气。
column2: Close to 竟然; carries surprise.

column1: 常和“一直、已经”等搭配。
column2: Often pairs with 一直/已经.

column1: 常见：临走、临出门、临考试。
column2: Common: 临走, 临出门, 临考试.

column1: 和“马上”接近，“立刻”稍正式。
column2: Close to 马上; 立刻 is slightly more formal.

column1: “包括”后面列出整体中的成员或部分。
column2: 包括 lists members or parts of a whole.

column1: “各自”强调每个人/每一方自己。
column2: 各自 stresses each person's/side's own.

column1: 常见于通知、标志和正式书面语。
column2: Common in notices, signs and formal writing.

column1: 作副词时表示“随时、一直”。
column2: As an adverb it means "at any time / all along".

column1: 较书面，常和“仍、还、没有”搭配。
column2: Rather formal; pairs with 仍/还/没有.

column1: HSK5量词语言点之一。
column2: One of the HSK5 measure-word points.

column1: 都是口语程度表达；“不得了”语气最强。
column2: All are colloquial degree markers; 不得了 is the strongest.

column1: “反而”表示与正常预期相反。
column2: 反而 marks the opposite of what's normally expected.

column1: 较书面，强调前面的行为带来后面的结果。
column2: Rather formal; stresses that the earlier act leads to the later result.

column1: 常见于书面语：位于、由于、对于、高于、低于等。
column2: Common in writing: 位于, 由于, 对于, 高于, 低于.

column1: 读 wéi；常见结构：以A为B、选为、认为。
column2: Read wéi; common: 以A为B, 选为, 认为.

column1: 常见：看起来、听起来、说起来、热起来。
column2: Common: 看起来, 听起来, 说起来, 热起来.

column1: 和“帮、给”有时接近，但“替”强调代替某人。
column2: Close to 帮/给, but 替 stresses doing it in someone's place.

column1: 口语感较强，表示可能性不确定。
column2: Fairly colloquial; expresses uncertain possibility.

column1: “似”在这里通常读 shì。
column2: Here 似 is usually read shì.

column1: 主语一般是复数或群体。
column2: The subject is usually plural or a group.

column1: 口语，有时语气较直接。
column2: Colloquial, sometimes rather blunt.

column1: “分别”强调一个一个、各自对应。
column2: 分别 stresses one by one / each respectively.

column1: “便”比“就”更书面。
column2: 便 is more formal than 就.

column1: 常有“没想到/相反”的感觉，语气比“却”柔和。
column2: Carries "unexpectedly/contrary", softer than 却.

column1: 常见：想来想去、说来说去、看来看去、走来走去。
column2: Common: 想来想去, 说来说去, 看来看去, 走来走去.

column1: 口语很常见；既可提建议，也可表示“否则”。
column2: Very colloquial; can suggest, or mean "otherwise".

column1: “互相”不能直接作定语；“彼此”可作主语/宾语/定语。
column2: 互相 can't be a modifier; 彼此 can be subject/object/modifier.

column1: “算”常表示按某个标准判断。
column2: 算 often means to judge by some standard.

column1: 可表示身份，也可表示用途。
column2: Can mark a role/identity or a use/purpose.

column1: 常和“过”一起表示过去经历。
column2: Often used with 过 for a past experience.

column1: 常用于解释、让步或提醒对方注意一个事实。
column2: Used to explain, concede, or point out a fact.

column1: 强调变化一步一步发生。
column2: Stresses that change happens step by step.

column1: 与“也许”接近，稍书面。
column2: Close to 也许, slightly more formal.

column1: 是趋向补语的引申用法，不一定表示真实移动。
column2: An extended directional use; not necessarily real movement.

column1: 较书面；常见“所说、所想、所需要、所看到”。
column2: Rather formal; e.g. 所说, 所想, 所需要, 所看到.

column1: 注意“相当”与“相当于”的结构不同。
column2: Note that 相当 and 相当于 differ in structure.

column1: 这里读 shù，不是 shǔ“数数”。
column2: Read shù here, not shǔ (as in 数数, to count).

column1: 多用于书面列举，通常连接最后一项。
column2: Mostly for written lists, usually joining the last item.

column1: 常见“达到……程度、严重程度、一定程度上”。
column2: Common: 达到…程度, 严重程度, 一定程度上.

column1: 后一情况通常比前面更明显、更不用说。
column2: The latter case is even more obvious, "let alone".

column1: 常用反问形式，意思是“没必要”。
column2: Often a rhetorical question meaning "there's no need".

column1: 通常说的是积极条件带来的好结果。
column2: Usually a helpful condition leading to a good result.

column1: 可中性解释概念，也可带怀疑/讽刺语气。
column2: Can neutrally explain a term, or carry doubt/sarcasm.

column1: 常见书面结构：而……则……；如果……则……。
column2: Common written patterns: 而…则…; 如果…则….

column1: 较正式、书面，相当于“被”。
column2: Formal/written, equivalent to 被.

column1: 常见搭配：说起、谈起、提起。
column2: Common pairings: 说起, 谈起, 提起.

column1: 常见“比不过、说不过、打不过、忙不过来”等。
column2: Common: 比不过, 说不过, 打不过, 忙不过来.

column1: 表示早晚一定会发生。
column2: Means it is bound to happen sooner or later.

column1: 较书面，通常修饰提醒、考虑、要求、说明等。
column2: Rather formal; modifies remind/consider/require/explain.

column1: “即”很书面，常见“即使、即将、即为、即可”。
column2: 即 is very formal; e.g. 即使, 即将, 即为, 即可.

column1: 强调不是大多数。
column2: Stresses it is not the majority.

column1: 语气较强；口语中也常见“非要……不可”。
column2: Rather strong; speech often uses 非要…不可.

column1: 较书面，常见“以……为……、以……方式”。
column2: Rather formal; e.g. 以…为…, 以…方式.

column1: 可表示“平时”，也可表示“普通”。
column2: Can mean "usually" or "ordinary".

column1: 用于两种选择中明确偏向一种。
column2: Used to clearly favor one of two choices.

column1: 比“很、非常”更强且更书面。
column2: Stronger and more formal than 很/非常.

column1: 表示除已经提到的部分以外剩下的。
column2: Means the rest, apart from what's already mentioned.

column1: 前面给事实/证据，后面给判断。
column2: First give the facts/evidence, then the conclusion.

column1: “般”较书面，常见“……般的、一般”。
column2: 般 is rather formal; e.g. …般的, 一般.

column1: 现代口语最常见的是“闻到、闻起来”。
column2: In modern speech the most common are 闻到, 闻起来.

column1: “趁”后面一般是有利时机。
column2: 趁 is followed by a favorable opportunity.

column1: 常见：买不起、住不起、承担不起、看不起（另有“轻视”义）。
column2: Common: 买不起, 住不起, 承担不起, 看不起 (also "look down on").

column1: HSK5量词语言点之一；“支”作动词还能表示支持、撑住。
column2: An HSK5 measure word; as a verb 支 can also mean support/prop up.

column1: 常见：凭经验、凭证据、凭什么。
column2: Common: 凭经验, 凭证据, 凭什么.

column1: 语气较强，常表示勉强、强行或固执。
column2: Rather strong; often reluctant, forced or stubborn.

column1: “偶然”强调事情出乎计划；“偶尔”强调频率低。
column2: 偶然 stresses "by chance"; 偶尔 stresses low frequency.

column1: 常用于请求、计划和正式沟通。
column2: Used in requests, plans and formal communication.

column1: 强调某个条件一发生，后果就会出现。
column2: Stresses that once a condition occurs, the consequence follows.

column1: 通常表示不希望发生但很难完全避免。
column2: Usually something unwanted but hard to fully avoid.

column1: “自从”后面是时间起点。
column2: 自从 is followed by a starting point in time.

column1: 常见：意见一致、保持一致、一致认为。
column2: Common: 意见一致, 保持一致, 一致认为.

column1: 常用于不知道、不方便说或不需要说具体是谁。
column2: Used when the specific person is unknown, awkward or needless to name.

column1: 和“多亏”相近，但“幸亏”后通常接小句。
column2: Close to 多亏, but 幸亏 is usually followed by a clause.

column1: 常见搭配：采取行动、立即行动、实际行动。
column2: Common: 采取行动, 立即行动, 实际行动.

column1: “义务”可作名词，也可修饰“劳动、教育”等。
column2: 义务 can be a noun or modify 劳动/教育.

column1: 和“往”接近；“朝”还可表示建筑物朝向。
column2: Close to 往; 朝 can also mean which way a building faces.

column1: 带强烈感情色彩，常用于夸张或惊讶。
column2: Strongly emotive; used for exaggeration or surprise.

column1: “来”表示约数时放在数词后；“一来二来”用于列两个理由。
column2: 来 for an approximate number goes after the number; 一来…二来… lists two reasons.

column1: 常用于话题转换；“不至于”表示程度没有那么严重。
column2: Used to switch topics; 不至于 means "not to that extent".

column1: 和“终于”接近；“总算”常带松一口气的感觉。
column2: Close to 终于; 总算 carries a sense of relief.

column1: 常见：定下来、记下来、保存下来、坚持下来。
column2: Common: 定下来, 记下来, 保存下来, 坚持下来.

column1: “舍”这里有放弃、割舍的意思。
column2: Here 舍 means to give up / part with.

column1: “自从”后需接起点；“从此”本身就是“从那个时候起”。
column2: 自从 needs a starting point; 从此 already means "from then on".

column1: 既可作动词引出假设条件，也可作名词。
column2: Can be a verb introducing a hypothesis, or a noun.

column1: 可表示数量“一堆”，也可作动词“堆起来”。
column2: Can mean the quantity "a pile", or the verb "to pile up".

column1: “与其”后是较不想选的做法，“不如”后是更好的选择。
column2: 与其 introduces the less-preferred option; 不如 the better one.

column1: 表示决定直接、不绕弯。
column2: Means deciding directly, without beating around the bush.

column1: 常说“以防万一、不怕一万，就怕万一”。
column2: Common: 以防万一; 不怕一万，就怕万一.

column1: 注意“无意做”与“无意中做”的区别。
column2: Note the difference between 无意做 and 无意中做.

column1: 反义词是“不利于”。
column2: Its antonym is 不利于.

column1: 与“确实”接近。
column2: Close to 确实.

column1: 不同语调表达不同态度，是口语交际语言点。
column2: Different intonations show different attitudes; a spoken-interaction point.

column1: “容易”多描述事情难不难；“轻易”多修饰人的动作。
column2: 容易 describes how hard a thing is; 轻易 modifies a person's action.

column1: 常见：关系密切、密切联系、密切相关。
column2: Common: 关系密切, 密切联系, 密切相关.

column1: 读 jǐnliàng。
column2: Read jǐnliàng.

column1: 比“逐渐”更强调有步骤、分阶段。
column2: More than 逐渐, it stresses steps/stages.

column1: 表示没有因为特殊情况而改变。
column2: Means unchanged despite special circumstances.

column1: 常在知道原因后表达“原来如此”。
column2: Expresses "so that's why" once the reason is known.

column1: “与其”提出放弃的选择，后面给更愿意选择的方案。
column2: 与其 gives the rejected option, then the preferred one.

column1: 放在总结性结论前。
column2: Placed before a summarizing conclusion.

column1: 这里的“过”是方向/路径，不是经历助词“过”。
column2: Here 过 is direction/path, not the experiential particle 过.

column1: 常见：打开、分开、离开、传开、让开。
column2: Common: 打开, 分开, 离开, 传开, 让开.

column1: 比“快”更强调抓紧时间。
column2: More than 快, it stresses hurrying.

column1: 可表示“一片叶子/面包/海/掌声”等。
column2: Can count 一片叶子/面包/海/掌声, etc.

column1: 副词时常和“不、没”一起使用。
column2: As an adverb it's used with 不/没.

column1: “除非”提出唯一或必要条件。
column2: 除非 introduces the only/necessary condition.

column1: 常见于“急得直哭、笑得直不起腰”等强烈状态。
column2: Common in strong states like 急得直哭, 笑得直不起腰.

column1: 常表示无论前面情况怎样，后面的结论不变。
column2: Means the conclusion holds regardless of the situation.

column1: 初学阶段先掌握最基本的“谁 + 做什么 + 什么”顺序。
column2: First master the basic order: who + does + what.

column1: “是”常连接身份、国籍、名称等；否定是“不是”。
column2: 是 links identity/nationality/name; the negative is 不是.

column1: 本册先掌握最基本的所属关系。
column2: First master the most basic possessive relationship.

column1: 句子的基本顺序不变，只在句末加“吗”。
column2: Keep the basic word order; just add 吗 at the end.

column1: 名词前表示数量时常用“两”，如“两个人、两个孩子”。
column2: Use 两 (not 二) before a measure word: 两个人, 两个孩子.

column1: 前文已经说过的问题可以用“呢”避免重复。
column2: Use 呢 to avoid repeating a question already mentioned.

column1: 本课重点量词包括“个、口”等。
column2: Key measure words here include 个, 口.

column1: 口语日期常用“号”，书面也常用“日”。
column2: Speech uses 号 for dates; writing often uses 日.

column1: 本课重点是这些句子可以不用“是”。
column2: The point: these sentences need no 是.

column1: “会”强调通过学习获得的技能。
column2: 会 stresses a skill gained through learning.

column1: 动作按照实际发生顺序排列。
column2: Actions are ordered as they actually happen.

column1: “怎么”主要询问动作的方法或方式。
column2: 怎么 mainly asks the method or manner of an action.

column1: 钟点表达按“小时→分钟”的顺序。
column2: Clock time goes hour → minutes.

column1: “吧”让建议、商量或请求的语气更柔和。
column2: 吧 softens a suggestion, consultation or request.

column1: 时间一般放在主要动词前。
column2: Time expressions generally go before the main verb.

column1: 和第4课询问“你呢？”不同，这里的“呢”用于陈述句末加强语气。
column2: Unlike the 你呢? of Lesson 4, this 呢 ends a statement to add emphasis.

column1: 本册先掌握最常见的方位词和“边”形式。
column2: First master the common location words and the …边 forms.

column1: “在 + 地点”放在动作前面。
column2: 在 + place goes before the action.

column1: “会”强调学会的技能；“能”更常表示条件允许或实际能力。
column2: 会 stresses a learned skill; 能 stresses being allowed/able.

column1: 这里的“有”重点是表示某处存在某人或某物。
column2: Here 有 stresses that someone/something exists at a place.

column1: 基本顺序：时间在前，处所在后，最后是主要动作。
column2: Basic order: time first, place next, then the main action.

column1: “第”把普通数词变成序数。
column2: 第 turns a plain number into an ordinal.

column1: “元”较正式，“块”是常用口语。
column2: 元 is formal; 块 is the everyday spoken word.

column1: 初级阶段可记：形容词前一般不用“是”。
column2: At this level: don't use 是 before an adjective.

column1: “怎么”多问方法；“怎么样”多问情况或评价。
column2: 怎么 asks how (method); 怎么样 asks about a situation or opinion.

column1: 正反问句末一般不用“吗”。
column2: A yes-no (V-not-V) question doesn't take 吗.

column1: “正在”的进行意味比“在”更强。
column2: 正在 signals "in progress" more strongly than 在.

column1: 本册重点理解“要”表示愿望、需要或近期计划。
column2: Focus: 要 for a wish, need, or near-future plan.

column1: 天气、自然现象等常可以不用明确主语。
column2: Weather and natural phenomena often need no explicit subject.

column1: 这里的“了”强调变化；第14课学习动作完成的“了（2）”。
column2: Here 了 marks change; Lesson 14 covers the completion 了(2).

column1: 既可表示“太……”，也可用于强烈感叹。
column2: Can mean "too…" or a strong exclamation.

column1: 本册重点是许可、允许的“可以”。
column2: Focus: 可以 for permission/allowing.

column1: 常用于短暂动作和礼貌请求。
column2: Used for brief actions and polite requests.

column1: 本课先掌握“给 + 人 + 东西”的双宾语结构。
column2: First master the double-object pattern 给 + person + thing.

column1: 和第12课句末“了（变化）”区分：这里重点是动作已经完成。
column2: Unlike the change 了 of Lesson 12, this stresses a completed action.

column1: 离合词形式像一个词，但中间可以插入“了、数量”等成分。
column2: Separable words look like one word but can take 了/quantity inside.

column1: “都”通常放在主要动词或形容词前。
column2: 都 usually goes before the main verb or adjective.

column1: “也”常表示另一人/事物情况相同；“还”常表示在已有信息上再增加一项。
column2: 也 marks "same for another"; 还 adds one more item.

column1: 第一册“吧（1）”主要表示建议；这里的“吧（2）”表示说话人有一个猜测，希望对方确认。
column2: Book 1's 吧(1) suggests; 吧(2) here marks a guess seeking confirmation.

column1: 肯定句中的“是”有时可以省略；本级先掌握最常见的强调方式、人物和目的。
column2: 是 can be dropped in positive sentences; focus on stressing manner, person and purpose.

column1: “请、让、叫”后的“人”既是前一个动词的宾语，也是后一个动作的执行者。
column2: After 请/让/叫, the person is both object of the first verb and doer of the next.

column1: 表示在几种可能中认为这个选择更合适。
column2: Marks this option as the more suitable among possibilities.

column1: “多”表示超过前面的数字一点儿，不表示精确数量。
column2: 多 means a bit more than the number, not an exact amount.

column1: 定语较长时通常要用“的”。
column2: Use 的 when the modifier is long.

column1: 常见结果补语：好、完、懂、到、见、错等；否定常用“没 + 动词 + 结果补语”。
column2: Common result complements: 好/完/懂/到/见/错; negate with 没 + verb + complement.

column1: 表示动作时间短、次数少或尝试一下，语气比较轻松。
column2: Marks a brief/few-times/tentative action, in a casual tone.

column1: 和“动词重叠（1）”相比，本点强调动作已经发生。
column2: Unlike verb reduplication (1), this stresses the action already happened.

column1: 否定常用“没（有）+ 动词 + 过”。
column2: Negate with 没(有) + verb + 过.

column1: 初学先掌握完整结构；口语中有时可省略其中一个关联词。
column2: Learn the full pattern first; speech may drop one connective.

column1: “的”后面的中心名词已经清楚时可以省略。
column2: The head noun after 的 can be dropped when it's already clear.

column1: 先掌握“来=朝说话人方向，去=离开说话人方向”。
column2: First learn 来 = toward the speaker, 去 = away from the speaker.

column1: 地点名词通常放在“来/去”前；事物宾语的位置更灵活。
column2: A place noun goes before 来/去; a thing object is more flexible.

column1: 常带提醒、惊讶或不满意的语气。
column2: Carries a reminding, surprised or displeased tone.

column1: 形容词重叠后一般不能再加“很、非常”。
column2: After reduplication, an adjective can't take 很/非常.

column1: 表示只举几个例子，还有类似内容没有全部说出来。
column2: Gives just a few examples, with more similar ones left unsaid.

column1: 简单记：修饰“怎么做一个动作”时，常用“……地 + 动词”。
column2: Simple rule: to modify how an action is done, use …地 + verb.

column1: 第二个动作通常紧接第一个动作发生。
column2: The second action usually happens right after the first.

column1: “得”后面说明动作的状态、程度或效果。
column2: After 得 comes the state, degree or effect of the action.

column1: 动词有宾语时不能直接说“他打篮球得很好”。
column2: With an object you can't say 他打篮球得很好 (repeat the verb).

column1: 最基本的“比”字比较句。
column2: The most basic 比 comparison sentence.

column1: “比”字句的形容词前一般不用“很、非常”，可以用“更、还”。
column2: In a 比 sentence use 更/还, not 很/非常, before the adjective.

column1: “虽然”提出事实，“但是”引出与预期不同的结果。
column2: 虽然 gives a fact; 但是 gives an unexpected result.

column1: 这是“比”字句的常见否定比较方式。
column2: This is the common way to negate a 比 comparison.

column1: “离”可以表示空间距离，也可以表示时间距离。
column2: 离 can express distance in space or in time.

column1: 时量补语表示动作持续的时间长度。
column2: A duration complement shows how long an action lasts.

column1: 大主语是全句话题，小主语和谓语一起说明这个话题。
column2: The big subject is the topic; the small subject + predicate comment on it.

column1: 选择问句使用“还是”，通常不用“或者”。
column2: Choice questions use 还是, not 或者.

column1: 有明确时间词时，教材特别强调常用“就要……了”。
column2: With a specific time word, the text prefers 就要…了.

column1: 这里强调状态持续，不是“正在做某事”的进行体。
column2: Here it stresses a lasting state, not an action in progress.

column1: 带宾语时的基本顺序是“动词 + 着 + 宾语”。
column2: With an object the order is verb + 着 + object.

column1: “最”表示在一个范围内程度最高。
column2: 最 marks the highest degree within a scope.

column1: “多了/得多”表示差别比较大。
column2: 多了/得多 shows a large difference.

column1: 比较的是动作的状态时，“比”的位置有两种常见形式。
column2: When comparing the manner of an action, 比 has two common positions.

column1: 重点是避免“动词+宾语+得”的错误顺序。
column2: The point is to avoid the wrong order verb + object + 得.

column1: 第一册“双宾语句（1）”主要学“给 + 人 + 东西”；这里增加“拿给、送给、卖给”。
column2: Book 1 taught 给 + person + thing; here add 拿给/送给/卖给.

column1: 数量短语说明“到底差多少”。
column2: A quantity phrase says exactly how big the difference is.

column1: 和第12课“多了/得多”相反，“一点儿/一些”表示差别较小。
column2: Opposite to 多了/得多, 一点儿/一些 shows a small difference.

column1: 第一册存现句（1）用“有”；这里学习“地点 + 动词着 + 人/物”。
column2: Book 1 used 有; here learn place + verb+着 + person/thing.

column1: 这里的“多”不是“多少”，而是感叹程度很高。
column2: Here 多 isn't "how many"; it's an exclamation of high degree.

column1: 本点先掌握“次”表示动作发生的次数。
column2: First master 次 for the number of times an action happens.

column1: 人名、地点名等位置较灵活；代词通常放在次数补语前。
column2: Names/places are flexible; pronouns go before the frequency complement.

column1: 第一册“有（1）”主要表示拥有/存在；这里的“有”表示数量达到某个程度。
column2: Book 1's 有 meant have/exist; here 有 means reaching a certain amount.

column1: “看上去”和“看起来”在表示外表印象时基本可以互换。
column2: 看上去 and 看起来 are basically interchangeable for outward impression.

column1: 这里的疑问代词不要求对方回答具体的人、事物或地点。
column2: Here the question word doesn't ask for a specific person/thing/place.

column1: 多项定语的顺序较复杂，本级先掌握常见顺序，不要求一次记住所有规则。
column2: Multiple modifiers are complex; just learn the common order for now.

column1: “又……又……”连接的两个部分通常词性相同。
column2: The two parts joined by 又…又… are usually the same word class.

column1: 此时“谁、什么、哪儿”等表示一个范围里的任何一个，不是在提问。
column2: Here 谁/什么/哪儿 mean "any one" within a range, not a question.

column1: 前后通常使用同一个疑问代词，表示自由选择或对应关系。
column2: The same question word appears twice, for free choice or correspondence.

column1: 口语中很常见，句末经常带“的”。
column2: Very common in speech, often ending with 的.

column1: 这里的“坏了”不是“变坏”，而是程度补语，表示程度非常高。
column2: Here 坏了 isn't "gone bad"; it's a degree complement meaning "extremely".

column1: “就”常让人感觉早、快、容易；“才”常让人感觉晚、慢、少。
column2: 就 feels early/fast/easy; 才 feels late/slow/few.

column1: “没”多否定已经发生的动作；“不”多否定习惯、状态或意愿。
column2: 没 negates completed actions; 不 negates habits, states or intentions.

column1: “一样”后面可以再接形容词说明哪方面一样。
column2: 一样 can be followed by an adjective saying in what way they're alike.

column1: “都”常表示排除一个例外；“还/也”常表示另外增加一项。
column2: 都 marks an exception (except…); 还/也 add one more.

column1: “得很”放在形容词后，口语中表示程度很高。
column2: 得很 after an adjective means "very" in speech.

column1: 量词重叠通常和“都”搭配，表示没有例外。
column2: Reduplicated measure words pair with 都 to mean "without exception".

column1: 句末的人或物通常是不确定、第一次出现的信息。
column2: The person/thing at the end is usually new, indefinite information.

column1: 两个动作有明显的先后关系，第二个动作紧接着第一个动作。
column2: The two actions are clearly ordered; the second follows right after.

column1: 表示到了做某事的时间，常带提醒语气。
column2: Marks that it's time to do something, often as a reminder.

column1: “如果”提出假设条件，“就”引出相应结果。
column2: 如果 sets a hypothetical; 就 gives the result.

column1: V1表示伴随状态或方式，V2是主要动作。
column2: V1 is the accompanying manner; V2 is the main action.

column1: “A不比B高”只说明A没有比B更高，A可能一样高，也可能更矮。
column2: A 不比 B 高 only means A isn't taller; A may be equal or shorter.

column1: “极了”放在形容词或少数心理动词后，程度比“很”强。
column2: 极了 after an adjective/mental verb is stronger than 很.

column1: 后一个分句通常比前一个分句增加一层信息。
column2: The second clause adds a further layer to the first.

column1: 这里“出、起、下”主要表示动作产生了某种结果，不一定是真正的空间方向。
column2: Here 出/起/下 mark a result, not necessarily real spatial direction.

column1: 离合词中间可以插入动态助词、时量或数量成分，不能总把它当作普通双音节动词。
column2: Separable verbs can take particles/duration/quantity inside; not ordinary two-syllable verbs.

column1: 本点强调“从某动作完成/某变化发生，到现在已经过了多久”。
column2: Focus: how long it's been since an action finished or a change occurred.

column1: “以前/以后”可以跟较长短语；“前/后”更简洁。
column2: 以前/以后 take longer phrases; 前/后 are more concise.

column1: “为了”后面是目的，后面的句子说明为这个目的做什么。
column2: 为了 states the purpose; the clause tells what's done for it.

column1: 可能补语强调“能不能达到某个结果”，不是一般的“能 + 动词”。
column2: A potential complement asks if a result is achievable, unlike 能 + verb.

column1: 两个“越”后面都可以接动作或状态。
column2: After each 越 you can put an action or a state.

column1: “把”后的宾语通常是明确、已知的事物；本点重点是动作后的地点。
column2: The 把 object is definite; focus here is the place after the verb.

column1: 这里的“上/中/下”不是简单方位词，而表示方面、环境或条件。
column2: Here 上/中/下 mark an aspect/environment/condition, not location.

column1: 本点重点是动作的接受者，用“给 + 人”表示。
column2: Focus: the recipient, shown with 给 + person.

column1: 最简单记法：选择问句用“还是”，陈述句表示选择通常用“或者”。
column2: Simple rule: 还是 in choice questions, 或者 in statements.

column1: “看来”表示根据已有情况作出判断。
column2: 看来 marks a judgement based on the situation.

column1: 动词后要有结果，不能只说“我把作业写”。
column2: The verb needs a result; you can't just say 我把作业写.

column1: 表示一个评价或判断是从谁的角度出发。
column2: Marks whose viewpoint an opinion comes from.

column1: 这是陈述句的选择关系，不是问句，因此不用“还是”。
column2: This is a statement's "either…or", not a question, so no 还是.

column1: 这里的“上/起来”表示动作或状态从没有到开始出现。
column2: Here 上/起来 mark an action or state beginning to appear.

column1: 本点的“就”强调范围或数量很小，意思接近“只”。
column2: Here 就 stresses a small scope/amount, close to 只.

column1: “下去”常强调继续向后发展；“下来”常表示保存、保持到后面。
column2: 下去 stresses continuing on; 下来 stresses keeping/settling.

column1: “的话”放在条件后面；前面可以省略“如果”。
column2: 的话 follows the condition; 如果 can be dropped in front.

column1: 本点强调“把”字句中的趋向补语，如出来、进去、过来、回去等。
column2: Focus: directional complements in the 把 sentence, e.g. 出来/进去/过来/回去.

column1: HSK3先掌握基本“被”字句；动作后通常要有结果、数量或其他成分。
column2: Learn the basic 被 sentence; the verb needs a result/quantity/etc.

column1: “再”常用于下一步动作；“然后”连接前后两个步骤也很常见。
column2: 再 is for the next step; 然后 also commonly links two steps.

column1: 很口语，常用于反驳对方刚才的判断，语气要结合场景使用。
column2: Very colloquial; used to rebut what was just said—mind the context.

column1: “根据”后面是判断、行动所依据的信息或标准。
column2: 根据 is followed by the basis for a judgement or action.

column1: 表示按固定数量分组或依次进行，常加“地”修饰后面的动作。
column2: Means in fixed groups or one by one, often with 地 before the verb.

column1: 和“看来”不同，“在……看来”明确说明是谁的观点。
column2: Unlike 看来, 在…看来 makes clear whose view it is.

column1: 表示经过的时间很短。
column2: Means only a short time passed.

column1: 重点是两个动作或状态交替出现，不是同时发生。
column2: The point is two actions alternate, not happen at once.

column1: 用于说明通常情况，不表示每一个人或每一种情况都完全如此。
column2: States the general case, not that every single instance is so.

column1: 这里比较的是动作在时间或数量上的具体差别。
column2: Here it compares a concrete difference in time or amount of an action.

column1: “向”常引出动作的方向或对象，如“向老师学习、向大家介绍”。
column2: 向 introduces direction/target, e.g. 向老师学习, 向大家介绍.

column1: 形式是问句，但常常不是为了得到新信息，而是强调说话人的判断。
column2: It's a question in form but stresses the speaker's judgement, not new info.

column1: 第二部分在前一层意思上进一步加强程度。
column2: The second part intensifies the degree of the first.

column1: “只有”提出必须满足的条件；没有这个条件，后面的结果通常不能发生。
column2: 只有 gives a necessary condition; without it, the result can't happen.

column1: 概数表示大概数量。本级重点复习相邻数字连用，并理解“来、左右”等常见约数形式。
column2: Approximate numbers: review adjacent-number pairs and forms like 来/左右.

column1: “刚才”可以单独作时间成分；“刚刚”是副词，通常放在动词前。
column2: 刚才 can stand as a time word; 刚刚 is an adverb, usually before the verb.

column1: “只要”表示这个条件一满足，后面的结果就能够发生。和“只有……才……”要注意区分。
column2: 只要: once met, the result can happen—distinguish from 只有…才….

column1: “从……起”强调一个新的时间或空间起点。
column2: 从…起 stresses a new starting point in time or space.
